text: You turn off the TV... and your brain won't stop talking.
In silence, your brain's daydream network takes over, and it replays your worries.
A rerun steals the spotlight. No cliffhanger, so your brain can finally let go.
The catch: left on all night, its light and sudden noise can disturb your sleep, without waking you up.
Keep the voice, lose the light: a podcast with a sleep timer. More tricks in the full video.
So next time the silence feels loud... now you know why.
